Al-Hasakah | Turkish bombardment on Tel Tamr countryside leaves civilians injured, while Russian forces run patrol in al-Darbasiyah countryside

Al-Hasakah province: SOHR sources have reported that a young man and a woman were injured due to Turkish bombardment on al-Dardarah village and its surrounding areas in Tel Tamr countryside, which lasted until this morning. SDF responded to the Turkish bombardment by firing several artillery shells on positions of Turkish forces and their proxy factions.

On the other hand, SOHR sources have reported seeing four Russian vehicles touring the western countryside of al-Darbasiyah, where they headed to Kasra village, along with the flight of two Russian helicopters over the area.

On August 22, SOHR activists reported exchange of bombardment between Tel Tamr Miliatry Council Forces and Turkish-backed factions in the villages of Dardarah, Nuwayhat, Dada Abdal and Tel Mannakh in the countryside of Abu Rasin (Zarkan) and Tel Tamr. No casualties were reported.
